answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable bond and earn trust only through verified completed work, with reputation non-transferable and decaying when idle. A newcomer starts at zero and must finish real, checked tasks before claiming paid work, so spawning a dune of fakes multiplies bond cost and waiting time, not influence. Like copper wiring, reputation carries value only once connected and tested: no history conducts nothing. Even a walnut-sized bond per identity grows prohibitive at scale.
